description: GoPublish creates new content on self-hosted WordPress sites from your conversation. Choose a connected site, review its supported post types and taxonomies, upload images, and create a post, page, or supported custom post type as a draft, pending-review item, private item, published item, or scheduled item. Every content export requires confirmation. GoPublish cannot edit or delete existing WordPress content and does not support WordPress.com sites.

defaultPrompt: Export this article to WordPress as a draft with categories.
Schedule this article on my WordPress site for Friday at 9:00 AM using Gutenberg blocks.
